text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
From here on, the days of racing through the Twinkle Series
with my partner Umamusume would begin.
The name of the girl who walks alongside me is—

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
My name is Rulership.
The ruler of the entire board.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
—Racing is, after all, the ultimate competitive game.
With the flawless strategy I formulate,
I will without a doubt seize absolute control over it all.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Fufu... Now then, shall we begin?
Let the thrilling, exhilarating game commence!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, our challenge for the Twinkle Series
with <chrname> began!
